en-US.name: DropZone Home
en-US.summary: Virtual yard lights, sprinkler and pet door for the DropZone drone drop zone demo.
en-US.description: DropZone Home exposes three virtual demo devices (Yard Lights, Sprinkler, Pet Door) that DropZone uses to help clear a drone drop zone. They are virtual: no real hardware is switched.

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Virtual devices only. Link with Login with Amazon, discover devices, then say: turn on yard lights, turn off sprinkler, lock pet door.
